cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je seznámení se s typologií čalouněného nábytku, zkládní tvorbou konstrukcí koster pro čalouněný nábytek, včetně konstrukčních vazeb, spojů a spojovacích součástí jednotlivých prvků. Praktické zpracování výkresové dokumentace v CAD.

cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: - Podmínkou udělení zápočtu je: 1) 100% účast na cvičeních s výjimkou pracovní neschopnosti z důvodu nemoci aj. pádných důvodů řádně doložených omluvným dokladem (neschopenka, doklad z úřadu, úmrtní list s účastí na pohřbu aj.) 2) absolvované, na daný termín, a v pořádku vypracovaný semestrální test na zadanou problematiku v klasifikačním ohodnocení A-E a to s možností jednoho opravného termínu, pro daný test. 3) splněné a na daný termín odevzdané semestrální programy (konstrukční výkres s kusovníkem) na zadanou problematiku. Programy jsou zadané v příslušném semestru na začátku probírání daného tématu. Programy, které budou vráceny k opravě či přepracování po termínu odevzdání, musí být nejpozději odevzdány do konce zápočtového týdne či jiný stanovený termín vyučujícím do konce zkouškového období vyukového semestru.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to become familiar with the typology of upholstered furniture, designing primary structures of frames for upholstered furniture, including construction of joints and fastener elements. Practical working drawings in CAD.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Construction of armchairs and fixed sofas - no function. (allowance 0/0) a.Materials, structural joints and connecting means (components) used in load-bearing frames of upholstered elements.b.Used structural joints in load-bearing frames of upholstered elements.c.Gliders and legs - base of load-bearing skeletons of upholstered elements.d.Attaching gliders and legs of upholstered elements.2.Armrest construction. (allowance 0/0) a.Materials of the supporting frame of the armrests.b.Used structural joints and connecting means (components) in supporting frames of armrests.c.Design solution according to shape.3.Construction of supporting frames of seats. (allowance 0/0) a.Seat support materials.b.Structural joints and connecting means (components).c.Relationship between the method of springing and the construction of seat supports.4.Construction of supporting frames of backrests. (allowance 0/0) a.Materials used.b.Structural joints and connecting means (components).c.Relationship between the method of springing and the construction of the supporting frames of the backrests.5.Construction of load-bearing skeletons of corner elements. (allowance 0/0) a.Materials, structural joints and fasteners (components).b.Typology and design of corner elements according to the floor plan shape.c.Ottoman, as a corner and seating element, in upholstered sets.d.Design solution of ottomans.6.Construction of load-bearing frames of folding upholstered products and products with function. (allowance 0/0) a.Upholstered products with the possibility of conversion into a bed - will allow occasional sleeping.b.Getting acquainted with the mechanisms of unfolding and with the possibility of changing positions.c.Getting acquainted with the manufacturers of these mechanisms and with fittings for the possibility of readjustment - adjustable fittings.d.Positioning function of upholstered furniture (for armrests, positioning in the connection of seat and backrest, positioning for: seats and seat board (footrests), seats and backrests (separately) and headrests).7.Construction of stool skeletons, end and extension elements, elements made of visible wood and shaped elements - from the point of view of elements completing the upholstered set. (allowance 0/0) a.Mutual relation to upholstered elements forming an upholstered set.b.Materials and used connecting mechanical means (components) in load-bearing frames.c.Construction concepts and structural connections in load-bearing frames.8.Packaging and shipping of upholstered products. (allowance 0/0) a.Principles and methods of packaging, for the dispatch of upholstered products from the manufacturer to shops and warehouses to the consumer.b.Principles and methods of packaging, for the dispatch of upholstered products by sea (water) transport.9.Safety and durability of upholstered products in relation to safety and health, respectively ecology. (allowance 0/0) a.Basic requirements for safety and durability of upholstered products according to currently valid technical standards and legislative requirements in relation to safety and health protection, respectively ecology.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The condition for granting the credit is: 1) 100% participation in exercises with termination of incapacity for work due to illness, etc. 2) completed, for a given date, and a semesterly prepared test for a given issue in the classification evaluation A-E, with the possibility of one corrective date, for the given test. 3) completed and submitted to the given term semester programs (construction drawing with a bill of materials) for a given issue. The programs are entered in the relevant semester at the beginning of the discussion. Programs that will be returned for correction or reworking after the submission deadline must be submitted no later than the end of the credit week or another deadline by the teacher by the end of the examination period of the semester.
